title: Galois Extensions via Finiteness of Orbits
summary: We present an orbit--theoretic reformulation of Galois theory based on the natural action of automorphism groups on fields. Given a field $\mathbf{E}$ and a subgroup $H$ of the automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbf{E})$, we show that algebraic properties of the extension $\mathbf{E}/\mathbf{E}^H$, where $\mathbf{E}^H$ denotes the fixed field of $H$, are encoded in the $H$-orbits arising from the action of $H$ on $\mathbf{E}$.
